description: One YAML, whole agentic pipeline. `source: + steps: + outputs:` — 5 ops (llm_call, route, debate, critique_loop, synthesize). Sibling of polars_pipeline / warehouse_pipeline / pyspark_pipeline / ml_pipeline for the LLM / agents domain. LiteLLM-backed, so any provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Bedrock, Ollama, ...) works via the `model:` string.

inputs.description: Source text — literal, url, file, or upstream_asset (kind = literal|url|file|upstream_asset).

outputs.description: One or more first-class asset outputs (declared via outputs.assets: [step_ids]); each is a dict `{text, ...op-specific fields}`. Plus optional text / json sinks.

asset_name_prefix.label: Asset Name Prefix
asset_name_prefix.description: Prefix for emitted asset names. Each step listed in outputs.assets becomes '{prefix}_{step_id}'.

source.label: Source
source.description: Data source. kind = literal | file | url | upstream_asset. All string fields are {partition_key}-templated.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Ordered pipeline steps. Each: {id, op, ...op-specific args}. Steps chain by id — a step with `source: <id>` reads that step's text; omit `source:` and it defaults to the most recent step's output. 5 ops available: llm_call | route | debate | critique_loop | synthesize.

outputs.label: Outputs
outputs.description: Output declaration. Shape: {assets: [<step_ids>], text_sinks: [], json_sinks: []}. `assets:` step outputs become first-class Dagster assets; sinks are side effects. All sink paths are `{partition_key}`-aware.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Group name for emitted assets. Default: 'agents'.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Additional tags for the emitted assets.
